context.body: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David.

observations.body: Jesus asks how scribes say the Christ is David’s son, cites David speaking by the Holy Spirit, and asks how the figure David calls Lord is his son.
observations.label: Mark preserves the Davidic lordship question: textual observation
